reason: A is the stronger proposal because it extends prior CrTaO4 evidence to the target alloy and tests protection for up to 100 h, rather than relying on B’s largely textbook assumption that only 2–5 at.% Al can establish continuous alumina despite cited evidence that low Al activity may be insufficient. A remains risky because high Ti/Zr/Hf activity may disrupt the Cr-rich scale and Cr-induced Laves phases may impair ductility, but these are directly testable in its controlled oxidation and mechanical comparison.
